correctness.rationale: For n≥3 an involutive partial dihedral restriction g|A must preserve A and satisfy g²|A=id. A rotation other than identity/half-turn has no nonempty fixed points of its square, so all nonidentity cases extend reflections or the even-n half-turn. A global involution with f fixed vertices and t transpositions contributes (1+z)^f(1+z²)^t invariant subsets; subtract partial identities. Distinct reflections never coincide on a nonidentity restriction; on even n=2h the half-turn agrees with a reflection only on one of h antipodal swapped two-point domains, giving correction −h z² and no higher collisions. This derives both odd/even formulas and first coefficients 1,n,n(n−1). At z=1, the nonidempotent count is O(n 2^(n/2)) versus 2^n identities; mixture bound yields total-variation distance O(n 2^(−n/2)) from Binomial(n,1/2). Independent deduplicated partial-map enumeration for n=3..9 reproduced involution totals 14,31,62,125,226,439,782 and every polynomial coefficient; the uniform proof is group-orbit classification, not finite induction.
residual_risks: Restricts global dihedral permutations to arbitrary subsets, not all partial graph automorphisms.
Finite n=3..9 checks corroborate but do not prove the all-n formula.
